# std.buffer

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Contiguous affine buffers and immutable arrays.

## Types

### `FixedBuffer`

```lang
struct FixedBuffer<T> { buf: Buffer<T>, cap: Int }
```

A buffer with a fixed capacity: it never relocates, and appending to a
full buffer returns `Full` (with the rejected value) instead of growing.

#### `FixedBuffer.capacity`

```lang
fn capacity(self: &Self) -> Int
```

#### `FixedBuffer.freeze`

```lang

```

#### `FixedBuffer.get`

```lang

```

#### `FixedBuffer.is_full`

```lang
fn is_full(self: &Self) -> Bool
```

#### `FixedBuffer.len`

```lang
fn len(self: &Self) -> Int
```

#### `FixedBuffer.pop`

```lang
fn pop(self: &mut Self) -> Option<T>
```

#### `FixedBuffer.push`

```lang
fn push(self: &mut Self, value: T) -> Result<Unit, Full<T>>
```

Append, or return the value back when the buffer is full.

#### `FixedBuffer.set`

```lang
fn set(self: &mut Self, index: Int, value: T) -> Unit
```

Checked write; an invalid index is a task defect.

#### `FixedBuffer.storage_address`

```lang
fn storage_address(self: &Self) -> Int
```

Address of the storage (never changes for a fixed buffer).

### `Full`

```lang
struct Full<T> { pub value: T, pub capacity: Int }
```

A fixed-capacity buffer was full; the rejected value is returned.

#### `Full.code`

```lang
fn code(self: &Self) -> Symbol
```

#### `Full.display`

```lang
fn display(self: &Self) -> String
```

## Functions

### `fixed`

```lang
fn fixed<T>(capacity: Int) -> FixedBuffer<T>
```

A fixed-capacity buffer (allocated once, up front).

### `freeze`

```lang
fn freeze<T>(b: Buffer<T>) -> Array<T>
```

Consume a buffer into an immutable array (reuses the allocation).

### `new`

```lang
fn new<T>() -> Buffer<T>
```

A new empty buffer (capacity hints are advisory).

### `with_capacity`

```lang
fn with_capacity<T>(capacity: Int) -> Buffer<T>
```
